fusions.name: Sonar Ping
fusions.desc: An emitter sends a locating pulse across a cone 4 tiles long, which deals 3 damage to everything in it, with a 35% chance to leave each [Leaden] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Ultrasonic Lance
fusions.desc: Fires an ultrasonic bolt that deals 13 damage to the first enemy it meets, stuns it for 1.2 seconds and leaves it [Muddled] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Dark Rangefinder
fusions.desc: For 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 1.3 times as far.

fusions.name: Answering Echo
fusions.desc: Each time you spend mana, a pulse leaps to the nearest enemy within 6 tiles and deals 6 damage. Once every 4 seconds.
